title: How local can an MIS answer be?
coverage: Bounded review of the eight supplied MIS-LCA sources plus one directly relevant deterministic lower-bound paper. Historical results are retained. This is not a claim of exhaustive current literature coverage. Fixed-tree comparisons are omitted.
lowerBoundStatus: A verified Ω(log* n) lower bound appears only for deterministic query-order-oblivious fixed-degree LCAs. No general randomized probe or joint-generation lower bound is claimed.
